name: Russia–Ukraine
value: Zaporizhzhia off-grid about 10 hours on 8 Nov
summary: Zaporizhzhia plant lost all off-site power for hours on 8 Nov; Abu Dhabi talks due from 10 Nov amid energy strikes
state: The Zaporizhzhia plant lost its sole 330 kV line on 8 Nov and ran on diesel generators for about 10 hours, the 27th such event, cause unknown (IAEA via Kyiv Independent). Strikes that day cut power to about 850,000 people, DTEK and local officials said, and Russia's defence ministry said it will keep hitting energy sites (Al Jazeera). The toll from the Komyshuvakha strike of 2 Nov stands at 55 killed (Ukrinform, 8 Nov). US-brokered talks in Abu Dhabi are due on 10–11 Nov.
for_you: Households in Ukraine face repeated power, heat and water cuts as winter begins. FCDO travel advice covers Ukraine and Russia, and Ukrainian civil-protection alerts are the official guide for people in the country.
rubric_hit: Alert: mass-casualty strike (55 killed at Komyshuvakha) and a nuclear-plant safety incident (Zaporizhzhia lost all off-site power on 8 Nov)
